text: Testing plays a key role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of code, like individual functions, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further and check how different parts of a system work together. Many developers use test-driven development, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think carefully about what the code should do. When tests are in place, developers gain confidence. They can change or improve the code without fear, because tests quickly show if something breaks. In short, good testing saves time and leads to more reliable software.
